 Hypersonic Festival Cancels All Dates Just Weeks Out
 By Lalo de Armas - October 29, 2026 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Australia’s Hypersonic Festival has canceled both of its 2026 events on short notice. The electronic music festival planned to return to Melbourne Showgrounds on November 20th before heading to Sydney’s Royal Randwick Racecourse on November 21st. Organizers cited scheduling conflicts surrounding the Melbourne date as the reason for cancellation. You’ll remember that Hypersonic is the successor event to the long-lost Supersonic Festival of the Golden Era. 
 According to their official statement, moving Melbourne’s event to a Friday created complications for the all-day festival format. The resulting “flow-on impact” meant organizers could no longer deliver either event to the standards expected by their artists and audiences.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by hypersonic festival (@hypersonicfestival.au) 
 A Major Lineup Without A Festival
 The cancellation comes with a substantial lineup already announced for Hypersonic’s second edition. Armin van Buuren was ready to headline for a second consecutive year, joined by W&W , Showtek , Charlotte Haining , Hybrid Minds and more.
 Hypersonic debuted in 2025 across Melbourne and Sydney with a lineup including Alesso , Steve Aoki , KREAM and Aaron Hibell . The cancellation, therefore, marks a significant disruption for a festival still in the early stages of establishing its reputation.
 What’s Next for Ticket Holders
 Fans who purchased tickets will have several options following the cancellation. According to Hypersonic’s social media announcement and website, all ticket holders can receive a full refund , which will be processed within 21 days.
 Alternatively, eligible ticket holders can transfer their Hypersonic ticket to Dreamstate 2027 with no additional cost attached. This requires them to complete a transfer form within seven days. Double Pass holders can also fill out a separate transfer form within seven days to similarly acquire a Dreamstate 2027 ticket while receiving a 50% refund. Double Pass ticket holders will receive a full, automatic refund if they choose not to entertain this offer.
 Links to the transfer forms and additional refund information can be found here .
 For now, organizers haven’t confirmed whether Hypersonic will return in 2027. Fans are left with quest marks regarding the festival’s future as what seemed to be a rising cornerstone of the Australian music community is plagued by uncertainty.
